FOO CHOW Ride

Pasadena, CA · Old Pasadena · Road

FOO CHOW Ride is a road group ride in Pasadena, CA. It rolls first Tuesday and Third Tuesday of the month at 7:00 pm from Incycle Pasadena. About 25–35 miles, medium to spicy, regroups at major turns and tops of climbs.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: medium to spicy, regroups at major turns and tops of climbs. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the FOO CHOW Ride group ride

Evening shop ride out of Incycle Pasadena twice a month. Pace runs medium to hard, but the group regroups at every major turn and at the top of long climbs. Bring lights, tools, a tube and water. No RSVP; sign the waiver and show up.
